name: idle-fade-whisper
title: Idle Fade Whisper
description: Ambient text that slowly fades toward invisibility while the reader is idle and breathes back on any input — presence-aware typography that rewards attention instead of demanding it.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Humanist
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Idle Decay: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
